dct_description_sm: The HRWP Study Area Boundary follows the Admin. Boundary shared between TRCA and Credit Valley Conservation Authority, Nottawasaga Valley Conservation Authority and Lake Simcoe Region Conservation Authority. This decision is justified by fact that TRCA does not manage or regulate areas outside of this boundary. Also, very limited additional areas (168.9 ha, 0.19% of Admin. Boundary) identified in Model Layer along this edge. The HRWP Study Area Boundary follows the Model Layer along all other boundaries. To keep consistency with Etobicoke Creek Watershed Plan Study Boundary in the north west of HRWP Study Boundary, 194 ha overlapping area is removed, and 28.3 ha additional area is added to fill polygon gaps.
